title: Benefits of Living in the City
sentences: This is a follow-up to the benefits of living in the countryside.
Because now I'm going to talk about the benefits of living in the city.
And there are many benefits of living in the city.
But this will of course depend on where in the world you live,
There are many differences, big differences between different cities.
In the sizes of cities for example,
it's something completely different to live in Haugesund in Norway,
which has about thirty, forty, maximum fifty thousand inhabitants,
compared to Oslo which has six hundred, seven hundred thousand inhabitants.
